from qiskit import transpile

compiled = transpile(qc, backend=backend, optimization_level=3)
caption: Rewrites every gate into the backend's native basis set, and maps logical qubits onto physical ones, respecting the coupling map.

caption: Before: a two-qubit circuit with a Hadamard and two CNOT gates, written the way you'd naturally write it.
